name: Vase
summary: This vase is made of fine porcelain painted in underglaze blue with a design of lotus flowers and foliage, the lotus in particular being a decorative motif associated with the East. Commonly known as 'Chinese blue-and-white', vases like this were used to decorate the interiors of many British homes
